# The Rune-Stone of the Threshold

A waist-high standing stone, its face crawling with carved glyphs that rearrange when unobserved.

**Read-Aloud**: *The stone rises from the floor like a tooth from a jaw. Its runes shift in the torchlight — no two readings the same — and the air before it feels thick, as though the world here has an extra seam.*

**Properties**: Radiates abjuration. Functions as a ward: while active, a 20-ft radius is warded against a chosen creature type (DC 15 to enter). Can be attuned to open a sealed door, or to speak one prophecy when struck.
**Lore**: Set by a mad architect to guard a stair; its twin opens the door it closes.
**Hooks**: The party needs its ward dropped, its twin found, or its prophecy interpreted.
